'''2001 Chewbacca Con Elimination Swiss (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG elimination swiss held at Holiday Inn, Boxborough, Massachusetts on 29 July 2001. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2763">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-madskills-day-2-boxborough-july-29thd2763/ madskills-day-2-boxborough-july-29th], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 1 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-madskills-day-2-boxborough-july-29thd2763/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Chewbacca Con]].

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn, Boxborough, Massachusetts
